attempts.title: Stop relying on asyncio.get_event_loop() to create loops
attempts.why: Replace implicit loop creation with a helper that uses the running loop, else the thread's loop, else creates and sets a new one.
attempts.diff:

+++ b/requests_html.py
@@ -21,6 +21,30 @@
 from parse import search as parse_search
 from parse import findall, Result
 from w3lib.encoding import html_to_unicode
+
+
+def _get_event_loop():
+    """Return the running loop, else this thread's loop, creating one if needed.
+
+    asyncio.get_event_loop() stopped creating loops implicitly in modern Python.
+    """
+    import warnings
+    try:
+        return asyncio.get_running_loop()
+    except RuntimeError:
+        pass
+    try:
+        with warnings.catch_warnings():
+            warnings.simplefilter("ignore", DeprecationWarning)
+            loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
+        if not loop.is_closed():
+            return loop
+    except RuntimeError:
+        pass
+    loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
+    asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)
+    return loop
+
